title: RdfReasoningCapabilities
description: What the RDF store's reasoning capability supports and whether it may run now. OpenMetadata reads this before submitting work and never falls back to reasoning in its own process.

readiness.description: READY admits jobs. NOT_READY means reasoning is enabled but cannot run safely, for example because the memory budget does not fit the container limit; reasons say why. DISABLED means reasoning is switched off.

engine.description: A reasoning engine and the profile it answers.

name.description: Engine name, such as HermiT, ELK or governance-rules.

profile.description: Fragment the engine answers, such as OWL 2 DL, OWL 2 EL or CONSTRUCT rules.

memoryBudget.description: The memory budget the store checks before admitting work: every JVM region is capped, and the capped total plus a page-cache floor must fit under the container limit with the safety margin.

containerLimitBytes.description: Container memory limit, or physical memory when unlimited.

requiredBytes.description: Limit the budget needs: (Fuseki heap + Fuseki off-heap + worker heap + worker off-heap + page-cache floor) / (1 - margin).

pageCacheFloorBytes.description: Page cache kept free for serving queries.

safetyMargin.description: Fraction of the container limit kept free, such as 0.1.

limits.description: Admission and execution limits. A job that reaches one stops without publishing a partial result, and a check answers INCOMPLETE. The store reports NOT_READY when a limit is unset.

maxClosureAxioms.description: Axioms in one ontology import closure.

maxDiskBytes.description: Disk for job directories, working datasets and snapshots together.

protocolVersion.description: Version of this reasoning protocol. OpenMetadata refuses versions it does not know.

reasons.description: Why reasoning is not ready, one sentence each.

coverage.description: OWL 2 constructs the engines answer with full semantics, by structural-specification name such as ObjectSomeValuesFrom or TransitiveObjectProperty. A closure using anything else is reported as incomplete, never approximated.
